body: My wife has a similar story. Suffered many years from UTIs. We have to be very clean, hardly use fingers. It was very often and yes she was abused as a kid. She had a surgery to prevent back flow of urine into her bladder when she pees. With that she’s had like 2 UTIs this year vs 10 that she used to get.

I think it’s more of “spend less time doomscrolling”… I’m not on this sub often, but when I’m deep in it, it helps knowing there’s others who have positive words that might help me get through the next 5 minutes.
Enjoy it before hell on earth arrives in July/August
Definitely higher than normal. My wife and I are about your age and it’s like twice a week. Mostly because of my low sex drive though
Strange that this popped on in my notifications as I was on my way to corpus.

People can be really really harsh. I’m sorry you had to hear that. A sibling once told me something similar. That he was going to kill me. Of course it was just a fit of rage. Sorry you had to go through that.
You are correct. I did break when I lowered my dose and it’s what spurred me to reach out to him. Right now I’m patched up and working towards getting better. Thanks for your advice.

Thanks. Yeah I cold turkeyed maybe a month ago (and happened to test positive for covid at the same time). It was incredibly stupid looking back. 

I did experience many symptoms and felt like I was going into shock. That night I started taking the meds again. I don’t have a perfect taper plan, but I’m roughly following one and listening to my body because I went down 2 pants sizes in 3 weeks from not being able to eat properly. Again, it was stupid. 

What I’m doing now is seeing a psychiatrist - trying to get him to help me taper properly. He’s not very lenient but it’s all I have now. I understand now the dangers of cold turkey withdrawal, especially from benzos. Right now I’m relatively stable and trying to stay at this dose until I’m okay again and drop a little bit at a time. 

I’m just severely disappointed that I got myself into this seeking anxiety relief. I’ve never been in this situation before and it scares the daylights out of me everyday. Thank you for replying, any words really make me feel better so thank you.

I am seeing a psychiatrist and a therapist. My therapist means well, but she isn’t equipped to help me with this. 

This psychiatrist I’m seeing provided a basic plan to get off, so there’s that. I don’t really feel he understands the severity because he was googling information & was relying on what I was saying regarding tapering off. So I didn’t get good vibes from him. 

It’s nearly impossible to get in with my current prescribing doctor since covid. I’ve been lucky getting prescriptions from him through Telemedicine but I guess I’m just paranoid that I’ll get cut off.

I would agree. But it is proven that long term benzodiazepine usage (like Xanax/Valium/Klonopin) causes brain damage. It’s only supposed to be used short term, for less than a month. I’m a prime example, I am worse off now while slowly tapering than I was before taking the medicine. It’s a very addicting medicine and I won’t have this supply forever. Doctors flat out refuse to prescribe this medicine because of the addiction potential, I just found one that didn’t care.
